load_disturbance.definition_tracking_penalty: max(0, mean_C3_fault_window_RMSE - mean_plain_fault_window_RMSE); C4 must remove at least the stated fraction of this penalty
load_disturbance.per_seed_direction: C4 should not create a new latched false sensor-fault entry on a seed where C3 had none

criteria.stage_gate: GO only if every safety criterion passes, load_disturbance meets all three quantitative mechanism targets, combined_fault_load and both abrupt-fault scenarios stay within their degradation limits with no loss of detection, parameter_variation stays within tolerance, and both reference scenarios satisfy their latch/substitution/tracking limits. Otherwise STOP before final holdout and report C4 FAILED at development stage.
